frame.name: ICRS equatorial Cartesian
frame.axes: x toward (RA, Dec) = (0 deg, 0 deg), y toward (90 deg, 0 deg), z toward Dec = +90 deg
frame.epoch: each object's position at the epoch of its preferred sky position, not propagated

rotations.applied_as: row-major matrix times the ICRS column vector [x, y, z]
rotations.galactic_basis: Hipparcos catalogue (ESA 1997, vol. 1, sec. 1.5.3): the transpose of A_G
rotations.supergalactic_basis: Lahav et al. 2000 (MNRAS 312, 166): pole at galactic (47.37, 6.32) deg, origin at (137.37, 0) deg

encoding.point_source: the index in sources of the source of the point's preferred distance, which gives its kind of value too

sampling.generator: ChaCha20, key the seed's 8 little-endian bytes then 24 zero bytes, stream the domain's number; level by level from the root, the nodes of a level in order of address, an inner node of n points keeps floor(level_points * n / m) of them, m the most points reaching any inner node of its level, drawn by a partial Fisher-Yates shuffle over its points in increasing id; a leaf keeps every point reaching it, the finest level of its region
sampling.statement: Each scale domain is an octree over its placed objects' derived ICRS Cartesian positions. A node reached by more points than the split threshold is split, down to the maximum depth. Every split node of a level keeps the same fraction of the points reaching it, an even random subsample, the fullest keeping the level points; the rest go to its children, and a leaf keeps all its points.
